protocol.purpose: Censor-aware remaining processing life, compared with frozen v3/v4; historical research, not a new blind test
protocol.outer: leave one complete electrode cycle out
protocol.inner: three deterministic groups of complete cycles; preprocessing fitted on training cycles only
protocol.selection: inner cycle-macro MAE + 0.5 * MAE in final two processing hours; fixed before this run
protocol.training: one origin per processing minute; each cycle has equal total training weight
protocol.interval: raw model q10/q50/q90, no data-dependent smoothing or warning lift
protocol.ipcw: Training-landmark censoring KM only; inverse weights capped by G >= 0.1; assumption-dependent diagnostic, correlated origins are not independent subjects
limits: Historical offline product eligibility remains a limitation
Prior research has inspected all historical cycles
No automatic promotion or field deployment
